ankeng.official: 安坑輕軌列車／安坑輕軌電聯車
ankeng.series: TRSC / Voith five-module low-floor LRV; Danhai follow-on procurement
ankeng.marketing: 光耀金 is livery, not engineering type
ankeng.engineering_type_code: UNVERIFIED: official operator/manufacturer pages do not assign a 2000 type code; do not derive type designation from fleet digits
ankeng.fleet_range: 201–215 sets; 2011–2155 individual module numbers, final digit 1–5. Secondary roster convention; complete official per-vehicle roster UNVERIFIED. Photographs confirm 2011 and 2101.
ankeng.batch: 15 follow-on sets / 75 modules; first arrival 2021-09-30, all delivered 2022-04-08; initial operation 2023-02-10
ankeng.livery: ordinary 光耀金; event wraps excluded

danhai.official: 淡海輕軌列車／淡海輕軌電聯車
danhai.marketing: 行武者號 / Warrior is voted exterior name; not evidence of an engineering product code
danhai.engineering_type_code: UNVERIFIED: no official 1000 type code or CAF Urbos / Skoda Artic family designation found
danhai.fleet_range: 101–115 sets; 1011–1155 modules, final digit 1–5. Secondary roster convention; complete official per-vehicle roster UNVERIFIED. Official/press photos confirm 1011.
danhai.batch: initial 15 sets / 75 modules; prototype revealed 2016-11-16, arrived 2016-12-23; volume production announced for 2017 (not proof of actual final delivery date); public opening 2018-12-23 / passenger trial 12-24
danhai.livery: ordinary original water-blue / white wave design, representative 1011; event wraps and temporary special liveries excluded
danhai.subcontractor_roles: ABB primary datasheet confirms BORDLINE CC400 compact converters / ESS for 15 TRSC Danhai LRVs. This is a traction product series, not the train model name.

geometry_sharing: Only this new family shares a photo-informed external envelope, module role scaffold and primitive surfaces. Independently keyed livery/role entries; no existing train shell modified. Exact housing dimensions are approximations, not a claim that supplier parts are identical. No third party mesh used.

dimensions.confidence: BIM says end modules nearly8m, suspended nearly6m, centre about4m. Display split fits official overall length; exact engineering joint centre distances unknown. No claim to engineering reproduction.
